title: Terrain/street layers baked with coordinates outside the board; only spawn centroids are bounds-checked
evidence:
if 0.0 <= tx <= BOARD_W_TILES and 0.0 <= ty <= BOARD_H_TILES:
                spawn_centroids.append([tx, ty])
detail: Only spawn candidates are bounds-checked. Baked asset contains terrain.water x=-4.22, park x=-0.54, arterial x=-1.40/y=-0.86 (Overpass `out geom` returns unclipped way geometry; 5,039 raw points beyond bbox). Preview PIL-clips, game consumers won't.
recommended_fix: After projection, clip terrain rings and street lines to the board rect (shapely .clip_by_rect(0,0,BOARD_W_TILES,BOARD_H_TILES)) or drop out-of-board geometry at bake.

title: Unclosed linear waterways (canal/coastline) chord-closed into fabricated water polygons
evidence: if nat == "coastline" or ww == "riverbank" or nat == "water" or ww == "canal" or ww == "dock":
detail: polygonize does Polygon(ls.coords) with no first==last ring check, auto-closing open lines. Verified from cache: Royal Canal (linear) became a fake 11,169 m² pond; 49 unclosed ways accepted as rings, one 1.82 km².
recommended_fix: In polygonize, reject rings whose first/last coords differ (or buffer canals by real width as lines); keep auto-close only for coastline where the chord hack is intended.

title: Multipolygon relations silently dropped: member rings concatenated role-blind into one self-intersecting LineString
detail: Outer+inner member ways are glued into one line; polygonize then returns None. Verified: 'Blessington Street Basin' (outer 11pts + inner 27pts) and 'Inner Dock' dropped; 43 of 52 water relations bake to nothing, unlogged.
recommended_fix: Build one LineString per member, polygonize each outer member separately (or shapely polygonize member rings honoring roles); log dropped relations.

title: Poisoned cache never self-heals: existence-only cache hit plus non-atomic write
detail: An interrupted write (open(path,'w') then killed) or a 200 non-JSON body (only '<remark>' screened) leaves a file permanently treated as a hit; every later bake crashes on uncaught json.JSONDecodeError until the cache is manually deleted.
recommended_fix: Write to path+'.tmp' then os.replace; on cache hit, validate json.load (delete/regenerate corrupt files instead of crashing).

title: gzip.decompress and body.decode exceptions are outside the mirror-fallback except tuple
evidence:
if resp.headers.get("Content-Encoding") == "gzip":
                    body = gzip.decompress(body)
            # Overpass reports errors as 200 JSON with a <remark> element
            text = body.decode("utf-8")
detail: except catches only (URLError, HTTPError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError); a corrupt gzip body (OSError) or non-UTF-8 response (UnicodeDecodeError) aborts the whole run instead of trying the next mirror.
recommended_fix: Widen the except to (OSError, ValueError) or wrap decode/decompress in the same try so a malformed response falls through to the next mirror.

title: fetched_utc embeds cache file mtimes, tying byte-identical bake to filesystem state
detail: Asset bytes include "fetched_utc": _fetch_time(cache_dir) from mtimes. Copying or restoring .osm-cache changes mtimes, so identical raw data (same raw_sha256) bakes different bytes, breaking the stated determinism contract.
recommended_fix: Derive fetched_utc from a timestamp recorded inside the cache file at fetch time, not from os.stat mtimes.

title: --verify with missing cache or unbaked output raises raw FileNotFoundError traceback
detail: The verify path skips fetch_raw entirely; missing cache files (load_raw) or a not-yet-baked out_path (a = open(out_path,'rb').read()) surface as uncaught FileNotFoundError tracebacks with no actionable message.
recommended_fix: In verify(), check cache/out existence first and SystemExit with 'run --fetch/--bake first' guidance.

title: Renderer palette lookups: silent black fallback for missing keys, but house_bodies indexed raw
evidence:
if v is None or len(v) < 4:
        return (0, 0, 0, 255)
detail: A renamed/missing token renders opaque black with no error, while palette["house_bodies"][0] (line 129) has no fallback at all — KeyError/IndexError on an empty list. Latent today: all referenced keys exist in data/palette.json.
recommended_fix: Fail fast on missing palette keys (or use one shared accessor with an explicit error naming the key) instead of divergent silent-black vs raw-index behavior.
